mapper.select: SELECT s.settlement_id, s.split_method, s.total_amount, s.settlement_status, s.created_by_member_id, vsm.share_amount AS viewer_share_amount, vsm.request_status AS viewer_request_status, EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM settlement_members paid_sm WHERE paid_sm.settlement_id = s.settlement_id AND paid_sm.request_status = 'PAID' AND paid_sm.deleted_at IS NULL ) AS paid_member_exists, creator.display_name AS requested_by, a.appointment_name AS gathering_name, COALESCE(t.memo, a.appointment_name) AS merchant_name, t.transfer_number AS transaction_number, payer.display_name AS paid_by FROM settlements s JOIN appointments a ON a.appointment_id = s.appointment_id JOIN wallet_transfers t ON t.transfer_id = s.source_transfer_id JOIN members creator ON creator.member_id = s.created_by_member_id JOIN members payer ON payer.member_id = s.payer_member_id LEFT JOIN appointment_members vam ON vam.appointment_id = s.appointment_id AND vam.member_id = #{memberId} AND vam.membership_status = 'ACTIVE' AND vam.deleted_at IS NULL LEFT JOIN settlement_members vsm ON vsm.settlement_id = s.settlement_id AND vsm.appointment_member_id = vam.appointment_member_id AND vsm.deleted_at IS NULL WHERE s.settlement_id = #{settlementId} AND s.deleted_at IS NULL AND (s.created_by_member_id = #{memberId} OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM settlement_members sm JOIN appointment_members am ON am.appointment_member_id = sm.appointment_member_id WHERE sm.settlement_id = s.settlement_id AND am.member_id = #{memberId} AND sm.deleted_at IS NULL AND am.deleted_at IS NULL ))

SELECT si.settlement_item_id, si.item_name AS name, sis.allocated_quantity, sis.allocated_amount FROM settlement_item_shares sis JOIN settlement_items si ON si.settlement_item_id = sis.settlement_item_id JOIN settlement_members sm ON sm.settlement_member_id = sis.settlement_member_id JOIN appointment_members am ON am.appointment_member_id = sm.appointment_member_id WHERE si.settlement_id = #{settlementId} AND am.member_id = #{memberId} AND si.deleted_at IS NULL AND sis.deleted_at IS NULL AND sm.deleted_at IS NULL AND am.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY si.source_order, si.settlement_item_id

SELECT DISTINCT t.transfer_id, am.appointment_id, t.initiator_member_id AS payer_member_id, payer_am.appointment_member_id AS payer_appointment_member_id, t.amount, c.decimal_places AS currency_decimal_places, tr.title AS journey_name, a.appointment_name AS gathering_name, a.appointment_name AS merchant_name, t.completed_at AS paid_at, payer.display_name AS payer_name FROM wallet_transfers t JOIN wallet_ledger_entries le ON le.transfer_id = t.transfer_id AND le.entry_type = 'DEBIT' JOIN trip_expense_links tel ON tel.ledger_entry_id = le.ledger_entry_id JOIN appointment_members am ON am.appointment_member_id = tel.appointment_member_id JOIN appointments a ON a.appointment_id = am.appointment_id JOIN appointment_members payer_am ON payer_am.appointment_id = am.appointment_id AND payer_am.member_id = t.initiator_member_id AND payer_am.membership_status = 'ACTIVE' AND payer_am.deleted_at IS NULL LEFT JOIN trips tr ON tr.trip_id = tel.trip_id JOIN members payer ON payer.member_id = t.initiator_member_id JOIN currencies c ON c.currency_code = t.currency_code LEFT JOIN settlements s ON s.source_transfer_id = t.transfer_id AND s.deleted_at IS NULL WHERE t.initiator_member_id = #{memberId} AND t.transfer_status = 'COMPLETED' AND s.settlement_id IS NULL AND t.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY t.completed_at DESC, t.transfer_id DESC

SELECT am.appointment_member_id, am.member_id, m.display_name FROM appointment_members am JOIN members m ON m.member_id = am.member_id WHERE am.appointment_id = #{appointmentId} AND am.membership_status = 'ACTIVE' AND am.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY am.appointment_member_id

SELECT sm.appointment_member_id, m.display_name, sm.share_amount, sm.request_status FROM settlement_members sm JOIN appointment_members am ON am.appointment_member_id = sm.appointment_member_id JOIN members m ON m.member_id = am.member_id WHERE sm.settlement_id = #{settlementId} AND sm.request_status <> 'NOT_REQUESTED' AND sm.deleted_at IS NULL AND am.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY sm.appointment_member_id

SELECT s.settlement_id, a.appointment_name AS title, s.total_amount, s.receivable_amount, s.split_method, s.settlement_status, s.created_by_member_id, s.created_at, s.completed_at, sm.share_amount AS viewer_share_amount, sm.request_status AS viewer_request_status, EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM settlement_members paid_sm WHERE paid_sm.settlement_id = s.settlement_id AND paid_sm.request_status = 'PAID' AND paid_sm.deleted_at IS NULL ) AS paid_member_exists FROM settlement_members sm JOIN appointment_members am ON am.appointment_member_id = sm.appointment_member_id JOIN settlements s ON s.settlement_id = sm.settlement_id JOIN appointments a ON a.appointment_id = s.appointment_id WHERE am.member_id = #{memberId} AND s.created_by_member_id != #{memberId} AND s.deleted_at IS NULL AND sm.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY s.created_at DESC, s.settlement_id DESC

SELECT s.settlement_id, a.appointment_name AS title, s.total_amount, s.receivable_amount, s.split_method, s.settlement_status, s.created_by_member_id, s.created_at, s.completed_at, sm.share_amount AS viewer_share_amount, sm.request_status AS viewer_request_status, EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM settlement_members paid_sm WHERE paid_sm.settlement_id = s.settlement_id AND paid_sm.request_status = 'PAID' AND paid_sm.deleted_at IS NULL ) AS paid_member_exists FROM settlements s JOIN appointments a ON a.appointment_id = s.appointment_id LEFT JOIN appointment_members am ON am.appointment_id = s.appointment_id AND am.member_id = #{memberId} AND am.membership_status = 'ACTIVE' AND am.deleted_at IS NULL LEFT JOIN settlement_members sm ON sm.settlement_id = s.settlement_id AND sm.appointment_member_id = am.appointment_member_id AND sm.deleted_at IS NULL WHERE s.created_by_member_id = #{memberId} AND s.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY s.created_at DESC, s.settlement_id DESC

SELECT t.transfer_id, am.appointment_id, t.initiator_member_id AS payer_member_id, t.amount, c.decimal_places AS currency_decimal_places FROM wallet_transfers t JOIN wallet_ledger_entries le ON le.transfer_id = t.transfer_id AND le.entry_type = 'DEBIT' JOIN trip_expense_links tel ON tel.ledger_entry_id = le.ledger_entry_id JOIN appointment_members am ON am.appointment_member_id = tel.appointment_member_id JOIN currencies c ON c.currency_code = t.currency_code WHERE t.transfer_id = #{sourceTransferId} AND t.initiator_member_id = #{memberId} AND t.transfer_status = 'COMPLETED' AND t.deleted_at IS NULL AND am.membership_status = 'ACTIVE' AND am.deleted_at IS NULL LIMIT 1
SELECT appointment_member_id, member_id FROM appointment_members WHERE appointment_id = #{appointmentId} AND membership_status = 'ACTIVE' AND deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY appointment_member_id

SELECT s.settlement_id, s.appointment_id, s.created_by_member_id, s.payer_member_id, s.source_transfer_id, s.idempotency_key, s.request_fingerprint, s.settlement_status, s.split_method, s.total_amount, s.payer_share_amount, s.receivable_amount, s.memo, s.version, c.decimal_places AS currency_decimal_places FROM settlements s JOIN wallet_transfers wt ON wt.transfer_id = s.source_transfer_id JOIN currencies c ON c.currency_code = wt.currency_code WHERE s.settlement_id = #{settlementId} AND s.deleted_at IS NULL FOR UPDATE

SELECT s.settlement_id, s.appointment_id, s.created_by_member_id, s.payer_member_id, s.source_transfer_id, s.idempotency_key, s.request_fingerprint, s.settlement_status, s.split_method, s.total_amount, s.payer_share_amount, s.receivable_amount, s.memo, s.version, c.decimal_places AS currency_decimal_places FROM settlements s JOIN wallet_transfers wt ON wt.transfer_id = s.source_transfer_id JOIN currencies c ON c.currency_code = wt.currency_code WHERE s.settlement_id = #{settlementId} AND s.deleted_at IS NULL

SELECT settlement_id, appointment_id, created_by_member_id, payer_member_id, source_transfer_id, idempotency_key, request_fingerprint, settlement_status, split_method, total_amount, payer_share_amount, receivable_amount, memo, version FROM settlements WHERE created_by_member_id = #{createdByMemberId} AND idempotency_key = #{idempotencyKey} AND deleted_at IS NULL

SELECT settlement_id, appointment_id, created_by_member_id, payer_member_id, source_transfer_id, idempotency_key, request_fingerprint, settlement_status, split_method, total_amount, payer_share_amount, receivable_amount, memo, version FROM settlements WHERE source_transfer_id = #{sourceTransferId} AND deleted_at IS NULL

SELECT sm.settlement_member_id, sm.settlement_id, sm.appointment_member_id, am.member_id, sm.share_amount, sm.request_status, sm.paid_transfer_id, sm.payment_idempotency_key FROM settlement_members sm JOIN appointment_members am ON am.appointment_member_id = sm.appointment_member_id WHERE sm.settlement_id = #{settlementId} AND sm.deleted_at IS NULL FOR UPDATE

SELECT sm.settlement_member_id, sm.settlement_id, sm.appointment_member_id, am.member_id, sm.share_amount, sm.request_status, sm.paid_transfer_id, sm.payment_idempotency_key FROM settlement_members sm JOIN appointment_members am ON am.appointment_member_id = sm.appointment_member_id WHERE sm.settlement_id = #{settlementId} AND am.member_id = #{memberId} AND sm.deleted_at IS NULL AND am.deleted_at IS NULL

SELECT sm.settlement_member_id, sm.settlement_id, sm.appointment_member_id, am.member_id, sm.share_amount, sm.request_status, sm.paid_transfer_id, sm.payment_idempotency_key FROM settlement_members sm JOIN appointment_members am ON am.appointment_member_id = sm.appointment_member_id WHERE sm.settlement_id = #{settlementId} AND am.member_id = #{memberId} AND sm.deleted_at IS NULL AND am.deleted_at IS NULL FOR UPDATE
SELECT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM settlement_members WHERE settlement_id = #{settlementId} AND request_status = 'PAID' AND deleted_at IS NULL )
mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO settlement_members (settlement_id, appointment_member_id, share_amount, request_status) VALUES
(#{member.settlementId}, #{member.appointmentMemberId}, #{member.shareAmount}, #{member.requestStatus})
INSERT INTO settlement_items (settlement_id, item_name, unit_price, quantity, line_total, source_order) VALUES (#{settlementId}, #{itemName}, #{unitPrice}, #{quantity}, #{lineTotal}, #{sourceOrder})
mapper.update: UPDATE settlement_members SET request_status = 'PAID', paid_transfer_id = #{transferId}, payment_idempotency_key = #{idempotencyKey}, paid_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE settlement_member_id = #{settlementMemberId} AND request_status = 'PENDING' AND deleted_at IS NULL

UPDATE settlements s SET settlement_status = 'COMPLETED', completed_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, version = version + 1 WHERE s.settlement_id = #{settlementId} AND s.settlement_status = 'REQUESTED' AND s.deleted_at IS NULL AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM settlement_members sm WHERE sm.settlement_id = s.settlement_id AND sm.request_status = 'PENDING' AND sm.deleted_at IS NULL )
